avoid_supplements.name: Probiotics (during active treatment)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Rifaximin kills bacteria non-selectively; concurrent probiotics may be neutralized, reducing therapeutic benefit
avoid_supplements.action: Separate probiotic administration by at least 2 hours from rifaximin doses; consider reintroduction after treatment completion

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce residual CYP3A4 activity and reduce efficacy of any systemically absorbed rifaximin metabolites
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout before starting rifaximin

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Rifaximin can reduce gut bacteria that produce endogenous vitamin K; supplementation may prevent deficiency
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of prolonged bleeding; counsel on adequate dietary vitamin K intake

caution_supplements.name: Fiber supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May alter gut transit and rifaximin distribution; excessive fiber could reduce contact time with pathogenic bacteria
caution_supplements.action: Take fiber supplements 2+ hours apart from rifaximin; maintain consistent intake

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly increase rifaximin absorption in the GI tract, though clinical significance is minimal given low systemic bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Consistency in meal timing is more important than composition; take with or without food as tolerated

caution_foods.name: Foods high in fermented/probiotic content (yogurt, sauerkraut, kefir)
caution_foods.mechanism: Live organisms may be killed by rifaximin, reducing intended probiotic benefit but not creating contraindication
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required; separate consumption by 2+ hours if possible to preserve probiotic viability

monitoring_notes: Rifaximin has minimal systemic absorption and few clinically significant drug-food interactions; primary concern is preservation of beneficial gut microbiota during and after treatment. Monitor for GI adverse effects and counsel patients on maintaining adequate hydration and nutritional status.
